prompt:
The chart below shows the number of holiday trips of five different kinds taken by residents of one country in 2005 and in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Holiday trips by type, 2005 and 2020
visual.alt: A bar chart comparing the number of trips made by residents of one country across five types of holiday in 2005 and 2020.

key_points: Total holiday trips rise from 21.0 million to 26.5 million
The most popular type of holiday changes: beach holidays in 2005 (8.4 million) and city breaks in 2020 (7.5 million)
City breaks more than double (3.1 → 7.5 million) — the largest increase
Beach holidays are the only category to show a clear fall (8.4 → 6.2 million); staying with relatives stays almost unchanged (6.0 → 5.8 million)
Walking in the countryside and outdoor sports holidays both nearly double but remain the two smallest categories in both years
common_mistakes: Listing all five types one by one instead of grouping them by rise/fall and showing the change in ranking
Rounding figures incorrectly or failing to state the unit (million trips)
Confusing 'people' with 'trips' — the chart gives the number of trips, not the number of people
Describing the two years in separate paragraphs without making any comparison
